subject: Next steps: vendor intake & PO routing for Pinecrest Labs

Subject: Next steps: vendor intake & PO routing for Pinecrest Labs

Hi Harper / Alan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed set of next steps so we can get vendor onboarding scoped and a PO in place quickly.

Call highlights:
- Goal: pilot Redwood Inference for inference workloads (chat + embeddings) in Q4, then expand to production in H1.
- Decision criteria: latency SLA (~150ms p95), ability to run in VPC, and proof of SOC2 controls.
- Economic buyer: Alan (confirmed verbally).

Action items we need to progress procurement:
1) Confirm the procurement contact and their intake form (so we can submit vendor packet).
2) Confirm invoicing entity and payment terms (Net30 vs Net45).
3) Any required compliance artifacts (SOC 2 report, DPA template) to include with our vendor packet.
4) Suggested target date for PO issuance (helpful for our internal capacity planning).

Attached: Pinecrest vendor intake template (blank) — please fill and return.

Proposed next step: 30-minute intake + legal ops sync next Tue (9/7) to walk through the vendor packet and invoicing fields. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on the intake so we can lock dates for the pilot.

—
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | (415) 555-0193

Thanks, Soojin — good recap. I filled out the vendor intake and attached it. A few clarifications from procurement/legal: 

- Procurement contact: Maya Li (maya.li@pinecrestlabs.com) — she owns vendor intake and PO routing. Please loop her on the packet submission.
- Economic buyer: confirmed — Alan Bennett (CTO).
- Invoicing entity: Pinecrest Labs, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789).
- Payment terms: Net30 standard; we can expedite to Net15 for pilots > $50k with finance approval.
- Approval timeline: procurement review + legal sign-off typically 3–4 weeks once intake is complete and SOW is agreed.
- Compliance asks: we need SOC 2 Type II summary and a standard DPA. Legal will provide redlines to your DPA if needed.

I’ve attached the completed intake form and a procurement checklist. If you can share a draft SOW and short SOC 2 evidence sheet, we’ll queue this for review.

Best,

harper@pinecrestlabs.com | +1 206-555-0122

- Invoice entity matrix (to confirm bill-to and remit-to fields).

- Tue 9/7: 30-min intake + legal ops sync (if that still works) — I’ll send an invite for 9/7 10:00am PT.
- 9/8–9/10: Redwood sends final SOW + SOC2 summary for review.
- 9/14–9/20: Procurement/legal review period.
- Target PO issuance: by end of September for a Q4 pilot start.

If procurement prefers a PO sample or specific field mapping (PO number formatting, cost center, billing code), please send the format and we’ll populate the invoice sample.

Thanks all — Ben/Irene, can you confirm which SOC2 artifacts you can provide this week and whether the SOW as attached is okay to circulate?
